reason: Release 61: #2100 (claude/rulings-1116): Ed, 2026-11-16: a legend's attack hits creatures for 50, not 10 ("50 a hit"; its lob, beam and charge alike), so any scene in which a legend fights creatures can go differently; and adults or legends in her stack no longer ground her at the treehouse ("Let her take off from the treehouse"). Declared in case a quick-bench scene has an angry or friendly legend in reach of creatures; if none differs, this is only a precaution; #2102 (claude/spell-glow-stronger): the creatures' spell glow is stronger (Ed, 2026-11-16: "Stronger"): brighter cores, a wider dithered halo, stronger pools and lights on the ground; the rules are untouched

rules.*: creatures a legend hits lose 50 health a hit, so a fight near a legend may end sooner and what follows it shifts

frames.wave-fight: wherever a creature's spell is in view, its glow is brighter and reaches further
